payload.title: Refresh sources, correct guides and detect broken links
payload.goal: Keep product guidance current through changed-source events and reviewed corrections.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Assign review TTL and next_check_at per source: product drawing stability, discontinued model and changed terms receive distinct triggers; conditional GET/hash checks avoid model calls on unchanged pages.
Collect source HTTP/redirect/content hash within allowed read limits; broken links, changed dimensions and conflict create evidence-review jobs, never automatic claim rewrites.
Generate focused guide changes from reviewed model evidence; check unique usefulness, dates, attribution, one H1/canonical, accessible links and disclosed limits.
Mark stale decisive source uncertain immediately; publish reviewed correction note referencing affected model/result versions through the existing release owner.
Retain editorial queue and source provenance; prioritize retrofit edge cases instead of duplicative generic best-product pages.
tests: 304/same hash causes no model call; changed dimension invalidates affected results and queues exactly one review.
404/redirect to unrelated merchant or lost source evidence removes confidence and prevents commercial routing dependent on it.
Guide fixture with unsupported testing claim, absent review date or broken local link fails release validation.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Each source has a freshness policy, due event, reviewed change disposition and next check.
An actual changed or expired source can lead to one correction with receiving-page readback and preserved prior evidence.
payload.rollback: Suspend disputed model recommendations and revert affected guide to last reviewed version; preserve correction trail.
payload.next_eligible_action: Implement conditional-fetch fixtures and stale-result invalidation offline.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Primary source availability affects individual records, not offline validator or unaffected guides.
